title: Fractions of Shapes and Groups
seo_title: Fractions – Primary 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Identify halves, quarters, fifths and sixths of shapes and of collections of objects; find a fraction of a number. (summary of the NERDC Primary 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 3 maths worksheets on fractions: halves, thirds, quarters, fifths and sixths of shapes and groups, and fractions on a number line. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A fraction is part of a whole that is cut into equal parts.
  • The bottom number tells how many equal parts. The top number tells how many we take.
  • To find 1/4 of 20, share 20 into 4 equal groups: 20 ÷ 4 = 5.

Examples

Example

1/5 of 30

30 ÷ 5

Answer: 6

Example

A cake cut into 6 equal parts, 1 part eaten

1 of 6 parts

Answer: 1/6

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Parts that are not equalFractions need equal parts.
Thinking 1/6 is bigger than 1/4More parts means smaller parts.
Counting the parts left instead of shadedRead the question carefully.
